overview.description: The Corgi Natural Gas Power & Turbines ETF (GASZ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in energy equity. GASZ.L is an actively managed ETF that provides exposure to companies from around the world involved in the natural gas power generation and turbine ecosystem. GASZ was launched on May 6, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.

holdings.infoBox: GASZ is an equity ETF with a total of 23 individual holdings. The top holdings are Caterpillar stock at 13.85%, GE Vernova at 10.98%, Kinder Morgan at 5.74%, Woodward at 5.20%, and Eaton Corporation at 5.16%.
